name: Dibrugarh

description.title: Dibrugarh – The Tea City of India
description.short: Known as the 'Tea City of India,' dotted with sprawling tea estates and river views along the Brahmaputra.
description.long: Dibrugarh, the 'Tea City of India,' is dotted with sprawling tea estates and river views along the Brahmaputra. Known for its friendly charm, it's also a base for exploring wildlife sanctuaries and nearby tribal villages. Blending greenery with quiet urban life, Dibrugarh is perfect for travelers seeking calm and culture.
description.history: Dibrugarh is the commercial hub of Upper Assam and is known for its tea industry. It's also a gateway to the eastern parts of Assam and Arunachal Pradesh.
description.overview: A peaceful city where tea plantations stretch to the horizon, offering tranquility and authentic tea experiences.

safetyInformation: Be cautious near the Brahmaputra River during monsoon.
Respect tea garden workers and their privacy.
Follow guidelines when visiting tribal areas.
travelTips: Take a tea estate tour to see tea processing.
Visit during tea harvesting season for best experience.
Explore nearby wildlife sanctuaries for nature lovers.
